content.comment_body: I'm pleased to share that over the past two weeks, I've developed a solution for interpreting communications between a [product_name] controller and a PC. The tool successfully monitors communication status, queries the controller's RUN/STOP mode, switches between modes, and reads real-time values from all digital and analog channels. Built in LabVIEW, it allows you to track all controller channels, select the communication port, and save data at customizable intervals. Tests with different logic modules have shown consistent performance. The attached image demonstrates possible system topologies with this protocol. I hope engineers working in micro-automation can benefit from this software, suitable for supervisory or data-logger devices. I'm open to helping others make use of it.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants showed strong interest in a LabVIEW-based solution for real-time communication and monitoring with [product_name] controllers. Key insights include requests for open access to communication protocols, flexibility for integration with platforms beyond LabVIEW, and capabilities to access and export data for use with other tools, such as C#/VB DLLs and Excel. Users also discussed the merits of this solution compared to more advanced controller lines, highlighting a need for adaptable, easily available tools within the [product_name] ecosystem.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easily accessible solution—ideally free—that allows seamless integration of [product_name] controller data with common development environments (LabVIEW, Excel, languages like C# and VB), complete protocol documentation, and options for customization or extended functionality.
